about: Small things the CLI e2e pass found (2026-09-28), the same in both CLIs. `clip`: a tool line is cut at a word boundary with an ellipsis, never mid-word (`clip_words` in Python webagents/cli/repl/render.py, `clipWords` in TypeScript src/cli/render.ts); a failed call's line keeps up to `failure_line_limit` characters, room for the file tools' refusals whole. `secrets_value_as_argument`: what `secrets set NAME VALUE` answers, exit 1 and nothing stored (it said "too many arguments for 'set'"). `prompt_expired_hint`: `-p`'s hint for a sign-in Robutler did not accept (the chat's says "Type /login", a chat command). `prompt_failure`: a failed `-p` in the format asked for, `json` one document on stdout and `stream-json` an error line, where both printed text; `no_model` is the code when no model can run. Read by python/tests/cli/test_final_sdk_low_items.py and typescript/tests/unit/cli/final-sdk-low-items.test.ts.

secrets_value_as_argument: `secrets set` takes the name alone: it asks for the value with echo off, or reads it from a pipe, so the value never lands in your shell history. Nothing was stored.
